Looking at the graph, for x > 2 the function follows the straight line passing through the open circle at (2, 4), the point (3, 3), and (6, 0). This line has equation y = -x + 6.

As x approaches 2 from the right, the values of f(x) along this line approach -2 + 6 = 4 (the height of the open circle).

Therefore, the right-hand limit is:

\boxed{4}
